# Crafts by Dev Chauhan

> A curated collection of interactive UI components, micro-interactions, and visual web blocks built with Vanilla JavaScript and CSS.

## Domain & Repository
- Website: https://craft.devchauhan.in
- Repository: https://github.com/dqev/craft

## Key Features & Components
- Search Bar with SVG Liquid Bridge
- Gooey Dropdown Menu
- Gooey Contextual Tooltip
- Split Action Button with Morphing State
- Pill Menubar Navigation with Fluid Slider
- Copy to Clipboard Button with Reicon Morph
- Animated Counter / Stepper
- Elastic Friction Slider
- macOS Dock Magnification Bar
- Stacking Toast Notification System

## Tech Stack
- HTML5 & CSS3 (Vanilla CSS with Custom Properties)
- Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+)
- SVG Filter Masking & Opentype.js Signature
